<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Furious Footfalls](/Classes.aspx?ID=57)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 70

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

The urge to fight drives you ever forward. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed. This bonus increases to +10 feet while you’re [raging](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802).
name: Furious Footfalls
